Curio Collection by Hilton Highlights Remarkable Characters Each Curio Collection by Hilton hotel is an individually remarkable hotel connected to sought-after destinations through distinctive, high-end architecture and locally inspired design that evokes each property’s bespoke story and creates a grand sense of arrival. Every property is different from the next and appeals to travelers seeking one-of-a-kind experiences around the world. Hotels are located in key urban and resort destinations where travelers want to be and explore. Destinations Unto Themselves From meaningfully curated services, rituals and high-end amenities, each Curio Collection is celebrated for its unique story and spirit as no two hotels are the same. Curio Collection hotels satisfy guests’ curiosity to explore authentic and remarkable discoveries through distinctly local offerings on or off-property and premier services that immerse guests in the unique culture and spirit of the destination for an authentic stay experience. World Class Culinary Moments From casual beachfront cocktails to top-rated refined tasting menus from Michelin Star chefs, Curio Collection provides iconic dining experiences for guests and culinary enthusiasts.
